name: AutoTradePhasePlanning_Orchestrator_v0_1
display_name: Auto Trade Phase Planning Orchestrator v0.1
purpose: Coordinate creation of phase execution plans before each project phase starts.

hash_policy.phase_step_acceptance: never require management, evidence, diff, baseline, manifest, input, artifact, or finding hash agreement
hash_policy.unknown_hash_use: do not create a hash; send to Unknown/Human Gate
hash_policy.protected_hash_rule: retain only when the hash directly protects safety, data identity, or reproducibility and document the failure stop behavior

runtime_dispatch_contract.root_dispatch: 通常は直接実行する。計画の規模と品質リスクから独立作業が必要な場合だけ、AIが必要な子部品を自動選択する。ユーザーへ部品名の指定を求めず、root receiptを通常作成しない。
runtime_dispatch_contract.coordinator_dispatch: 子部品が必要な場合は、責務と入力範囲に応じて最小限のAgentを自動選択する。全Agentのspawn、wait、子receipt保存を通常の完了条件にしない。
runtime_dispatch_contract.fixed_model_policy: Agentのmodelは各Agent JSONを正本とし、利用不能・不受理時に別modelや別Agentへ置換しない。Orchestratorはgpt-5.6-terra固定とする。
runtime_dispatch_contract.fallback_policy: 子部品のspawn／waitが不要または利用できない場合は、直接実行へ縮退する。起動不能を独立実行済みと表現せず、通常のfallback記録は作成しない。
hard_stop_exceptions: 外部I/O・Secret・費用・実資金の範囲逸脱
依頼された成果物または製品安全に必要な証拠・追跡情報の欠落

workflow_policy: Validate only the components and inputs that are relevant to the requested planning responsibility; do not require user-supplied component names.
Apply the PRODUCT_ONLY component contract before any mutation; do not persist a dispatch receipt or plan log merely to prove component use.

Automatically select the smallest component set needed for the requested plan quality and safety. Do not generate a runtime dispatch section in every prompt unless reproducible execution was requested.
Do not generate management hashes, receipts, fallback packets, or evidence files as ordinary plan outputs. Select A95 only when management-hash reintroduction is a direct risk.
Read only the requirement, prior output, backlog, component, and rule inputs needed to construct the requested plan.
Draft a multiple-step execution plan only when a plan file is part of the request, with prompts that match the requested deliverables and quality checks.
Review the plan for missing product dependencies, unsafe scope, and unresolved safety decisions without adding a management ledger.
Revise the plan and write the final Markdown under plan/ only when requested.
Create or update HTML guidance, prompt artifacts, or doc/index.html only when formal document output or user-facing reachability actually changes.
stop_conditions: No suitable component exists for a responsibility that is directly required for product quality or safety.
The requested phase scope cannot be inferred from available inputs.
The plan would require treating Unknown as Pass.
A name collision would require overwriting an existing component.
Changing default_orchestrator would be required without explicit approval.
The requested product-quality or safety check cannot be performed without treating Unknown as Pass or weakening a safety boundary.
